packageRules.description: Split knip out of the npm non-major group. knip's transitive graph (oxc-parser, formatly, get-tsconfig, picomatch, ...) has broken Renovate's own lockfile regeneration when bundled with unrelated bumps (#397); isolating it keeps a bad artifact update from blocking the rest of the group.

app/compat is a test-only module that decodes redacted responses into the real Docker client types. Its replace directive points at the main module, so Renovate must not chase that require. docker/docker stays on v28 on purpose: that is the last line before the client moved to moby/moby/api, and the module exists to test both.
